newsitem.title: ITALY: BASKETBALL-BARCELONA WIN, ITALIAN HOPES KILLED OFF.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-BARCELONA WIN, ITALIAN HOPES KILLED OFF.

text.p: Last year's losing finalists Barcelona, avoiding controversy with a hefty defeat of Bologna, and Olimpija Ljubljana killed off Italy's dreams of Final Four basketball glory on Thursday.

Spain's Barcelona swept past Bologna 87-62 to stay on course for another crack at Europe's top men's prize while Slovenia's Ljubljana beat Stefanel Milan 77-61 in their quarter-final third-leg deciding match.
Although the Italians went quietly on the court the same could not be said for their fans, with some scuffles after the Stefanel game in Milan.
Witnesses said some Milan fans got past police and approached celebrating Slovenians. There were a few minor scuffles before they were separated.

The build-up to Barcelona's decisive leg of the quarter-final had been coloured by a tirade of protest from an irate Italian official disgusted by Bologna's controversial defeat in the second leg on Tuesday in Spain.
Barcelona, who lost the first encounter 70-65, beat the Italians 75-73 in the second match after the British referee blew time as Bologna's Dan Gay netted a potentially tie-winning three-pointer.
The defeat caused much anger in Italy with league president Angelo Rovati saying Italian clubs and their backers were fed up with being "taken for a ride."

But there was no argument on Thursday as Barcelona outclassed their tired and less experienced rivals with Ramon Rivas (16) the top scorer on a night when Yugoslav playmaker Alexander Djordjevic took a back seat with six points.
Barcelona dominated in every area. They were ahead 4-3 after 50 seconds and never looked back.

Gay, wearing a transparent plastic face mask to protect a nose broken several times this season, had a muted match with 10 points behind Carlton Myers on 21 thanks to four three-pointers and Eric Murdock on 19 with three.
Murdock missed six three-pointers and after nine minutes Barcelona were 59-34 ahead and uncatchable.
